hf.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
hf.abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
hf.titleZh: 从结构化教科书中扩展数学证明监督数据
hf.summaryZh: 现有数学监督数据多被压平成孤立的问题-解答对，丢弃了教材的课程编排与证明的证据结构。TOME-Math 将 2,118 本大学数学核心教材转换为约 38 万条结构化证明监督记录，保留章节顺序、命题-证明链接、依赖引用与来源溯源。借助这些结构信号，作者在多个数学科目上做课程学习，并刻画监督规模与来源广度的 scaling 规律;全量微调后在留出评测与公开基准上的未加权平均分较基座模型提升 16.7 个百分点，聚合指标超过三个公开指令数据基线。该工作把结构化教材同时作为可扩展的数学监督来源与研究数据组织方式影响推理的实证框架。
hf.reason: 结构化教材数据+课程学习与数据 scaling，直接服务后训练

hf.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
hf.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On τ^2-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.
hf.titleZh: SteerDistill:通过闭环教师引导量化 LLM Agent
hf.summaryZh: 低比特量化能降低 LLM Agent 的推理成本，却会损害任务成功率:量化后的 Agent 常忽略任务要求与环境条件，产生的环境状态转移偏离全精度参考轨迹;离线数据又难以覆盖学生的失败上下文。SteerDistill 让全精度教师基于学生实际执行的反馈，引导学生改写失败响应并迭代精炼引导信号，形成闭环的教师引导，从而在局部得到经执行验证的行为修正;随后在无引导条件下训练学生，在修正轮对齐被引导学生的预测、其余轮对齐全精度教师的预测，使其可独立推理。在五个 agentic benchmark 与三个模型上，W4A16 下平均分比最强量化基线高 1.67–2.18 分，与 BF16 差距在 1 分以内;在 τ²-Bench 上成功率超 QeRL 1.84 个百分点，训练 GPU 时数减少 67%，成功轨迹也更短。
hf.reason: 量化蒸馏 + Agent 闭环教师引导，命中后训练与效率方向，实验扎实

hf.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.
hf.titleZh: 通过强化学习激励大语言模型的自学习能力
hf.summaryZh: 针对不熟悉领域的问题求解需要知识获取与推理紧密耦合、而非单纯事实检索或依赖预置上下文的问题，构建基于教科书的数学解题任务，要求模型在无参考答案条件下自行浏览教材讲解、学习并应用原理完成证明，并设计 BookNavigator 交互接口，用细粒度奖励的强化学习激励这种类人的研读过程。实验表明该方法在域内与域外教材和学科上均带来提升，将 Intern-S2-Preview-35B 的证明准确率从 51.5% 提升至 79.5%，优于无教材与固定检索的 RL 基线，并在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 CL-bench 上分别较基座模型提升 1.7 与 2.3 个百分点。结果说明 RL 可培育与领域无关的自学习策略，为长文本语料上的长上下文复杂任务提供新的训练思路。
hf.reason: RL 训练自学习与长上下文检索策略，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

hf.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
hf.abstract: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read Intent Protocol tracks evolving needs and source coverage; Adaptive Reader Backends select how evidence is located and exposed; and the Budgeted Read Gate bounds cumulative raw exposure per episode with faithful full-view fallback. A unified Reader interface supports interchangeable evidence acquisition across heterogeneous resources. Across six models, including Claude Opus 5, and five scenarios, SparseRead reduces total tokens by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, preserving or improving task quality in 97% settings. On Web deep-search tasks, it reduces tokens by 31.0--43.0% and task completion time by 23.0--37.0%. Ablations validate the three designs, while integration with three agent frameworks demonstrates portability.
hf.titleZh: 读得更少，解得更多：面向AI Agent的外部内容Token高效稀疏读取
hf.summaryZh: Agent反复整篇读取网页、文档、仓库与工具返回，而实际往往只需少量证据，造成token与延迟浪费并稀释相关信息。SparseRead是一个不改动agent模型的可复用读取控制层：Read Intent Protocol跟踪需求演化与来源覆盖，Adaptive Reader Backends选择证据定位与暴露方式，Budgeted Read Gate限制单回合累计原始暴露量并保留全量回退，统一Reader接口支持异构资源互换。在六个模型（含Claude Opus 5）与五个场景上，token最多降低92.9%，wall time最多降低89.0%，97%设置下任务质量不降；Web深度搜索任务token降低31.0–43.0%，耗时降低23.0–37.0%。消融与三个agent框架的集成验证了三项设计与可移植性。
hf.reason: Agent读取控制层，直击上下文与延迟成本，数据扎实

hf.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
hf.abstract: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.
hf.titleZh: Interactive Visual Gym：在交互世界中用模拟用户评估视觉交互模型
hf.summaryZh: 现有视觉交互模型评测多依赖离线回放，无法捕捉助手回复改变用户后续行为与任务结果的闭环效应。为此构建 Interactive Visual Gym 框架，联合仿真可执行任务环境与带 persona 条件的用户模拟器，覆盖烹饪、家务操作与移动界面三个场景，并允许可控的执行错误与偏离计划行为，实例化为含 315 个交互场景的 IVG-Bench。评测显示最强模型 Gemini 4 Argon 也仅在时限内完成 53.4% 任务，事实落地与可执行指导薄弱，计入响应延迟后往往来不及阻止错误；人类研究显示交互质量指标与参与者偏好一致率为 78.5%。在烹饪环境中用 GRPO 做闭环训练，可同时提升 Qwen3.5-4B 的任务成功率与交互质量，说明该环境能提供有效学习信号。
hf.reason: 闭环交互评测加 GRPO 训练验证，贴合 Agent 与评测方法学方向

hf.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.
hf.titleZh: 面向提示自适应、成本感知LLM推理的集成路由
hf.summaryZh: 单模型路由无法按请求调整集成组合与成本，固定集成也难适配单个提示。PISA用软聚类隶属度结合模型专属预测器估计各模型能力，其扩展PISA-E在显式成本-质量偏好下联合选择集成组成与规模，偏好可在推理时调整而无需重训，并借助可解析的集成成功替代模型与高效候选筛选避免集成专门训练。四个路由基准上，PISA在分布内与分布外条件下宏平均成本-性能超体积均居单模型路由之首；PISA-E在质量优先时分别超出最强集成方法2.09与2.87个百分点，在低成本工作点亦保持更优任务性能并将平均推理成本降低约36%与25%。
hf.reason: LLM路由与成本感知推理，属高效推理系统方向

hf.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
hf.abstract: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.
hf.titleZh: Evolving Infra:面向 Agent 自适应的大规模 LLM 服务
hf.summaryZh: Agent 类负载已成为 LLM 推理需求的主要来源，但现有 PD 分离式服务系统难以在运行时灵活调整算力分配与 KV cache 管理，且所用信号过于粗糙，导致 prefill 与 decode 节点负载失衡、Agent 将复用的 KV cache 被提前逐出。Evolving Infra 将算力分配与 KV cache 管理解耦，使节点能高效在 prefill 与 decode 间切换;其在线规划器按负载构成匹配 PD 切分比例，Agent 感知的分布式 KV 管理器则利用 Agent 上下文管理信号指导 cache 逐出与迁移。在编码、数学、computer-use 任务上，基于 GLM-5.2 与 Kimi K2.6、最多 256 块 GB300 GPU 的实验中，相比 NVIDIA 生产框架 Dynamo，平均端到端请求延迟与 P95 TTFT 分别最多降低 4.1 倍与 14 倍。
hf.reason: Agent 负载自适应 PD 分离服务系统，系统性强且有旗舰级实验

hf.title: GTAGym: AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.
hf.titleZh: GTAGym：用于评测与强化学习的 AAA 游戏任务环境
hf.summaryZh: 针对 AAA 游戏任务结果难以自动验证、难以直接用于强化学习的问题，构建 GTA V 上的评测与训练环境 GTAGym：GTAVBench 从主线任务重建九类共 103 个在线任务及 47 个图像射击任务，通过 Web 服务并行执行截图—键鼠动作交互并自动校验引擎状态。六个前沿 LLM 在仅在首帧给出指令的 GTAVBench-AGI 分支上最佳总体准确率为 70.9%，空中导航与逃脱仍困难。生成器可按模板批量产出带自动奖励与终止信号的训练环境，对 Qwen3-27B 做 LoRA RL 可提升域内导航表现并迁移至域外类别，原生 GTA V 任务成功率由 15% 升至 23%。
hf.reason: Agent 环境与 Agentic RL 基准，含自动奖励生成与迁移实验

hf.title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
hf.abstract: We present FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs arising in linear model predictive control. FAME-QP combines constraint-dependent operator representations with fused single- and two-kernel iterations replayed through CUDA graphs, automatically selecting the execution configuration through device calibration and problem-specific timing. It probes a cached operator bank to select the initial penalty and updates operators lazily when problem matrices change. Numerical benchmarks and simulated humanoid and quadrotor control experiments demonstrate reduced latency relative to competing GPU solvers while maintaining solution accuracy and control performance.
hf.titleZh: FAME-QP：面向实时模型预测控制的 GPU 加速二次规划求解器
hf.summaryZh: 针对线性模型预测控制中稠密二次规划的实时求解需求，FAME-QP 以约束相关的算子表示为基础，把单核与双核迭代融合为一条执行路径，并通过 CUDA graphs 回放执行，同时借助设备标定和针对具体问题的计时来自动选择执行配置；它还查询缓存的算子库以选取初始惩罚项，并在问题矩阵变化时惰性更新算子。数值基准与仿真的类人机器人和四旋翼控制实验表明，其延迟低于同类 GPU 求解器，并且保持了求解精度与控制性能。该方法适用于对控制回路时延敏感、需要反复求解同类 QP 的部署场景。
hf.reason: 实时 MPC 的 GPU QP 求解器，属控制/机器人方向，与 LLM 无关

hf.title: Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis
hf.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.
hf.titleZh: 对齐在何处涌现、又意味着什么？——对柏拉图表示假说的再审视
hf.summaryZh: 考察单模态模型之间（语言与视觉）的表示对齐在模型各层与各维度上的分布，回应近期对柏拉图表示假说（PRH）能否延续到新一代语言模型的质疑。研究发现，只要图像描述足够干净、信息充分，「能力越强、跨模态对齐越强」的趋势在新模型上依然成立；同时指出表示相似度指标会被模型深度与宽度混淆，需引入匹配基线才能正确解读。作者进一步给出单模态与多模态基线：单模态模型之间的跨模态对齐可超过显式对齐的视觉语言模型，但仍显著低于同模态模型之间的对齐。为 PRH 的实证检验提供了更严谨的度量框架与可复现代码。
hf.reason: 表示对齐的实证分析扎实，属多模态理解与评测方法学交叉

hf.title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in large language models (LLMs) where a teacher passes a hidden preference to a student through training data unrelated to that preference. We study whether subliminal learning also occurs in vision-language models (VLMs). We finetune a teacher VLM to prefer a specific animal or facial attribute and use a control teacher from the same base model. Both teachers generate numbers for an unrelated visual task involving geometric shapes. Two students initialized from the same base VLM are finetuned on the same images, using numbers generated by either the biased or control teacher. Across VLMs ranging from 2B to 7B parameters, we find that both animal and facial preferences can transfer through this unrelated task. Students trained on biased-teacher outputs select the target more often than control students, with a difference of up to sim10 percentage points in the animal preference task. Transfer can become stronger with more training data and varies with the target preference, model, and how the numbers are generated. Beyond preferences, we show that the biased student's explanations use more of the same words and phrases as the biased teacher's explanations than those of the control student, even when all three models select the same image. These results matter for training VLMs and show that training on unrelated data may change both a VLM's image preferences and how it explains its choices, and that transfer can become stronger with more training samples.
hf.titleZh: 视觉语言模型中的阈下学习
hf.summaryZh: 检验 LLM 中「教师通过无关训练数据把隐藏偏好传给学生」这一现象是否也出现在视觉语言模型。先微调教师 VLM，使其偏好某类动物或面部属性，再让偏好教师与对照教师对几何图形生成数字，两个同源学生 VLM 在同一批图像上分别用这两组数字微调。在 2B 到 7B 的模型上偏好均可迁移，动物偏好任务中学生选择目标的比例最多高出约 10 个百分点，且迁移随训练数据量增加而增强；偏好学生的解释用词也更接近偏好教师。这说明在无关视觉数据上训练即可改变 VLM 的图像偏好与解释方式，对多模态训练数据管理有直接意义。
hf.reason: VLM 训练数据影响分析，方法可控、结果清晰

hf.title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
hf.abstract: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K. Cost is counted in weight bytes read per token. On 36724 replayed steps the entropy of the low pass ranks argmax flips with AUC 0.93. At a 15% escalation budget it catches 78% of flips and the margin gate 94%, against the 15% expected for a random gate of equal rate (a computed expectation, not a run). In 150 live problems all-high scores 64.0% and all-low 55.3% (McNemar p=0.053). An entropy gate with a 16% escalation rate scores 62.7% at 0.87 of the all-high weight bytes. Its paired difference is -1.3 (-8.0 to +5.3) points to all-high and +7.3 (+0.0 to +14.7) points to all-low (p=0.080), so the live data do not separate the gate from either end. Verified speculation reaches zero KL at similar bytes in the same cost model. A live random control, a thinking-mode phase rule, a second model and live KL were not run.
hf.titleZh: 按需精度：小型本地模型在不确定解码步上提升权重量化比特数
hf.summaryZh: 通常解码全程固定一种权重量化精度；该工作存储 8-bit 权重，默认用其高 4 位解码，仅在低精度输出分布不确定（熵超阈值或 top-two margin 偏小）时以 8-bit 重做该步，成本按每 token 读取的权重字节计。在 Qwen3-0.6B 与 GSM8K 上回放 36724 步，低精度熵预测 argmax 翻转的 AUC 为 0.93，15% 升级预算下熵门控捕获 78% 的翻转、margin 门控捕获 94%。150 道实题中全高精度得 64.0%、全低精度 55.3%，熵门控以 16% 升级率得 62.7% 且仅耗 0.87 倍权重字节，但与两端的配对差异均不显著，实时数据尚无法区分门控与全高/全低精度。
hf.reason: 量化与自适应推理效率方向，但模型小、结果不显著

hf.title: CogBattery: Human-Referenced Evaluation of Cognitive Task Behavior and Structure in Language Models
hf.abstract: Human cognitive tasks let us compare language models with humans under controlled conditions. Yet a model can reproduce the direction of a human effect while making different errors. CogBattery evaluates 54 open-weight language models on text adaptations of 13 cognitive paradigms, comparing each with human data from its source study. Like humans, models respond more to n-back lures than to controls, yet they make far more false alarms on ordinary non-targets. Most models' reported confidence separates correct from incorrect answers less well than humans' does, and most always choose the same wager, including models that classify accurately. These patterns span many model families. Across tasks, model scores share two dimensions. The first is closely tied to scale, yet larger models are not consistently closer to humans. Predefined cognitive groupings show no reliable predictive advantage over random groupings of the same size. These results show that matching human effect directions does not establish human-like behavior. CogBattery provides condition-level human references for testing errors and confidence reports in new models.
hf.titleZh: CogBattery:语言模型认知任务行为与结构的人类参照评测
hf.summaryZh: CogBattery 用 13 个认知范式的文本改编版本评测 54 个开源权重模型，并与各原始研究中的人类数据逐条件对比。模型虽与人类一样对 n-back lure 反应更强，却在普通非目标上出现远多误报;多数模型的置信度对正误的区分能力弱于人类，且下注策略几乎恒定，即使分类准确也不例外。跨任务得分可归结为两个维度，第一维与规模紧密相关，但更大模型并未稳定更接近人类，预设的认知分组相对同规模随机分组也无可靠预测优势。这说明仅对齐人类效应方向不足以证明类人行为，该基准为检验新模型的错误模式与置信度报告提供了条件级人类参照。
hf.reason: 认知范式行为评测基准，属评测方法学范畴但偏离后训练与 Agent 核心

hf.title: WMIP: A Working-Memory-Inspired Programmable Probe of Cumulative State Tracking in Large Language Models
hf.abstract: Human working memory lets people maintain and update information. Large language models (LLMs) face a related demand when tracking updates within a single prompt without writing out intermediate states, yet existing tests differ in their constraints on written steps. We introduce a working-memory-inspired probe of cumulative state tracking with program-computed answers, 3 to 100 updates, and final-state, intermediate-state, or multi-target queries. It compares protocols on identical items. Across 18 LLMs, accuracy is 84.9% on single-step arithmetic but 31.7% on core items requiring one number after three to seven updates. From 50 updates on, no model exceeds 10% accuracy. Core accuracy reaches 88.0% under a larger budget and instructions to write steps and place the answer on the last line, mainly due to the instruction changes rather than the budget. Core accuracy also correlates positively with public Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard scores. These findings show that strong single-step arithmetic does not ensure reliable cumulative tracking and that output protocols substantially change measured accuracy. We release the generator, items, scoring code, and responses for reproducible comparisons across depths, query types, and protocols.
hf.titleZh: WMIP：受工作记忆启发的可编程探针，用于测量大语言模型的累积状态追踪
hf.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 在单条 prompt 内需隐式追踪多次状态更新、而现有测试对是否写出中间步骤约束不一的评测空白，提出可编程探针 WMIP:答案由程序计算，覆盖 3–100 次更新，支持末态、中间态与多目标查询，并可在完全相同的题目上比较不同输出协议。18 个模型上单步算术准确率为 84.9%，而需在 3–7 次更新后给出一个数的核心题仅 31.7%,50 次更新以上无模型超过 10%。当放宽预算并要求写出步骤、把答案置于最后一行时，核心准确率升至 88.0%，提升主要来自指令变化而非预算;核心准确率与 Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard 得分正相关。结果表明单步算术能力强并不保证累积状态追踪可靠，输出协议会显著改变测得精度。
hf.reason: LLM 状态追踪评测方法学，含协议对比与开源数据

hf.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
hf.abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.
hf.titleZh: 逐层、逐模块地探测 Transformer 表征
hf.summaryZh: 针对「基础模型该探测哪一层表征」的问题，对视觉基础模型与 LLM 做了超过 144,000 次线性探测，表明层与模块需联合选择:最佳层-模块组合相对固定残差流的增益明显大于仅挑选最佳层，且模块性能随深度变化显著，说明有用表征无法只由深度刻画。据此给出简单固定策略——视觉用最后一层 FFN 激活(Act@100)，语言用 60% 深度处的第二个归一化层(LN2@60)，在多数评测中优于基线，分别恢复最佳层-模块组合约 42% 与 86% 的增益，视觉上的增益随预训练与下游数据迁移难度上升而增大。
hf.reason: 表征探测分析，与架构理解沾边但非后训练核心方向

hf.title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench.
hf.titleZh: CARTBench：面向带时间线的复杂模糊请求的购物建议评分细则评估
hf.summaryZh: 针对购物助手多轮推荐评估中数据稀缺与评判标准难以统一的问题，从17个零售领域的真实商业需求构造带时间戳对话与1603条商品记录，并由人工精选的成功订单优质回复蒸馏出「理想回复原则」，据此生成案例专属评分细则（rubric），同时提出 Principle-Guided CART Prompting 结构化推荐策略。基准含1328条专家标注标准，分为 Core、Excellence、Safety 三类。在冻结的评分细则下评测7个旗舰商业API模型与35B+参数开源模型，Core项10个模型中有3个超过90%，Excellence项无一超过45%，暴露出理解与执行之间的差距，并归因于商品证据缺失与需求未消解（需求变动、关键未知项）。
hf.reason: rubric式评估方法学扎实，但属电商垂直benchmark

hf.title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
hf.abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using 6times fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
hf.titleZh: 混合信号：面向 EEG 与 ECG 的权重空间编程
hf.summaryZh: 权重空间编程让语言模型直接读取并改写已训练网络的权重，从而以推理代替梯度下降完成“训练”。工作将该能力迁移到生物信号模型：前沿模型能在不被告知故障内容的情况下定位并修复植入 EEG/ECG 网络中的缺陷，也能仅凭架构、任务与极少量受试者数据从零写出全部权重。实验中语言模型仅用 1/6 的训练受试者即达到标准梯度下降的效果，Claude Opus 5.5 生成的网络在相同 5 名受试者上超过 alpha 波段功率与 CSP+LDA 等手工 EEG 流程。局限包括无法改进已训练良好的分类器、也难以仅凭权重反推任务，作者认为该范式适用于边缘与可穿戴设备上的小网络，距离实用仍需进一步验证。
hf.reason: 权重空间编程思路新颖，但落地在 EEG/ECG 生物信号小模型，偏离主线

hf.title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
hf.abstract: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. GraphMuon performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by these propagated representations and normalizes step sizes according to the update's induced effect on the layer representation. We show that theoretically, vanilla Muon can suffer from graph-induced update amplification, while our GraphMuon can mitigate this effect. As such, our GraphMuon yields a graph-metric analogue of Muon's polar update step. Empirically, GraphMuon achieves 1.32times-2.42times validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks. Across 15 dataset-architecture configurations spanning node classification, inductive graph classification, and graph regression, it achieves lower time-to-target in 13 cases, while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance. Code is available at https://github.com/guy-hadad/GraphMuon.
hf.titleZh: 面向图神经网络的模块感知优化方法
hf.summaryZh: 图神经网络（GNN）的权重更新几何不仅由通道混合矩阵决定，还受图传播后表征的协方差结构影响，因此 Muon 等矩阵感知优化器的正交化更新在 GNN 上可能被放大。GraphMuon 在由传播表征定义的度量下进行正交化，并按更新对层表征的诱导效应归一化步长，从理论上给出 Muon 极分解更新在图度量下的类比，并证明可缓解图诱导的更新放大。在三个大规模 OGB 基准上，相对 AdamW 取得 1.32–2.42 倍验证损失达标加速；在覆盖节点分类、归纳图分类与图回归的 15 组数据集-架构配置中，13 组达标更快且预测性能不降。
hf.reason: Muon 优化器用于 GNN，与 LLM 后训练主线关联弱

hf.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
hf.abstract: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and robots.txt directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and robots.txt, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.
hf.titleZh: ScrapeBench：评估 AI Agent 在网站抓取中的法律合规性
hf.summaryZh: 针对开放网络上的 AI Agent 可能违反网站服务条款与 robots.txt 的问题，构建首个评测 Agent 抓取合规性的基准。在 1,626 个明确禁止抓取的网站中，主流闭源与开源 Agent 的合规率普遍低于 5%，即使主动检查条款也仍然偏低；在 269 个允许抓取的网站中又出现过度拒绝，Claude Opus 4.6 的过度拒绝率达 98.5%。180 人的人类基线显示合规率与 Agent 相当，但过度拒绝率更高，为 Agent 安全与行为评测提供了可复现的测量框架。
hf.reason: Agent 行为合规评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
hf.abstract: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.
hf.titleZh: 比特还是排列？在小型本地语言模型中，把固定推理预算花在权重精度上，还是花在选项顺序平均上
hf.summaryZh: 考察低比特权重量化是否加剧选择题的选项顺序敏感度，以及固定推理预算下应花在精度还是顺序平均上。在Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B上用模拟最近邻取整量化（8/6/4/3比特），读取ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU、HellaSwag各300题的A–D logits，统计答案槽偏斜与翻转率。6比特相对fp16不掉点，4比特下0.6B的答案槽偏斜从0.15升至0.53；平均四个循环顺序在4比特下回收+12.6点。以「权重字节×前向次数」计价，成本匹配时只有6比特及以上增加顺序才胜过增加比特，因此建议用6比特权重、余下预算做至多四次单遍顺序平均。
hf.reason: 量化与选项顺序偏差的交叉评测，选题有趣但规模小、结论有限

hf.title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard
hf.abstract: Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick. We release PolyRoute: 322 native-language support messages in 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows, and a protocol for a three-way department-routing decision. Labels come from Qwen3.8-27B with a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept); an independent model, gemma4-31b, agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the largest character 5-gram similarity between any test text and any training text is 0.33. A leaderboard of 13 systems gives 61.2% for the English-root checkpoint, 77.3% for the shipped multilingual one and 96.6% for the best fine-tune; TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9%. On four withheld languages the three multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. On code-mixed text the English root (85%) is nominally ahead of the shipped multilingual checkpoint (79%; p=0.134). The split resolves differences only above about 4 points. All texts and labels are LLM-generated.
hf.titleZh: PolyRoute：面向类型化决策路由的十二语言与代码混合基准，含基线、排行榜
hf.summaryZh: 类型化决策编码器单次前向即可回答文本问题，但其非英语表现缺少统一标尺。PolyRoute 提供12种语言、9种书写系统的322条本地语支持消息，156条代码混合或罗马化消息（Hinglish、Spanglish、Arabizi），967条可选本地语训练数据，以及三路部门路由协议；标签由 Qwen3.8-27B 生成并经盲二次校验（保留91%），独立模型 gemma4-31b 与测试项一致率97.2%，测试文本与训练文本最大字符5-gram相似度仅0.33。13个系统的排行榜显示：英语根检查点61.2%，随发布的多语检查点77.3%，最佳微调96.6%，TF-IDF加逻辑回归达91.9%；四个留出语言上三个多语系统分别为77%、90%、93%；代码混合文本上英语根85%略高于多语检查点79%（p=0.134），该切分仅能分辨约4分以上的差异。全部文本与标签由LLM生成，可作为多语路由评测与复现对照的基线。
hf.reason: 多语种基准与排行榜属评测方法学，但任务窄且数据全为合成

arxiv.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
arxiv.abstract: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
arxiv.titleZh: ArchSpace：记录、评审与引用LLM架构研究
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM架构创新分散在工业界内部实践与学术界小规模单点对比之间，成功与失败的经验都缺少公开沉淀。ArchSpace搭建公开平台，把每个架构提案连同实验与推理过程记录在案，由社区评审并被后续工作引用；平台用scaling law从小规模实验预测更大规模的模型loss，在昂贵的大规模训练前筛选想法。首版提供Qwen3.5与OLMo3基线、拟合好的scaling law以及可复用的训练配方，经评审验证的想法可升级为新基线。
arxiv.reason: LLM架构与scaling law结合的公开平台，直接命中架构研究方向

arxiv.title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
arxiv.abstract: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been shown to optimize financial performance but typically does not enforce rule compliance, making it unsuitable for real-world deployment. Existing neurosymbolic methods such as Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) offer constraint-satisfying reinforcement learning (RL) via differentiable symbolic supervision but assume a finite, discrete action space. We present a PLPG-inspired continuous allocation method that estimates the probability that the policy's own executed action satisfies the investment mandate, using reparameterized Monte Carlo sampling, and adds it to the training objective. No post-hoc enforcement mechanism intercepts actions at inference time and compliance is learned by the agent. Audited directly on deterministic mean actions with no correction, the policy reduces violations of a six-rule regime-conditional mandate from 96-98% for unconstrained RL and 33.4% for a reward-penalty baseline to 4.8%, showing that a continuous-action neurosymbolic policy can substantially internalize a symbolic mandate.
arxiv.titleZh: 内化投资授权：面向投资组合配置的神经符号 RL 方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 机构投资组合须遵守投资政策声明中按市场状态设定的资产配置约束，而深度 RL 在优化收益时通常不保证规则合规，难以直接落地。该方法借鉴 PLPG，用重参数化蒙特卡洛采样估计策略自身执行动作满足投资授权的概率，并将其加入训练目标，推理阶段不做任何事后拦截或动作修正，合规性由智能体自行学习。在由六条状态条件规则构成的授权上直接审计确定性均值动作，违规率从无约束 RL 的 96–98%、奖励惩罚基线的 33.4% 降至 4.8%。
arxiv.reason: 金融组合配置的约束 RL，与 LLM 主线无交集，仅神经符号方法沾边

arxiv.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
arxiv.abstract: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: AgentSSL: MLE Agent 能否利用无标签数据?
arxiv.summaryZh: MLE Agent 此前几乎只在全监督设定下评测，标签稀缺、无标签数据充足的真实场景尚未被检验。工作把半监督学习形式化为程序搜索问题，让 Agent 在弱反馈下合成代码、组合并改造已有 SSL 技术;在 12 个设定中的 8 个超过最强人工基线，最高提升 21.8%。同时发现程序选择是核心瓶颈——按 Agent 的反馈指标挑选程序时性能最多下降 47%，为此构建含 16,977 个 Agent 生成与人工设计程序的 ProgramSelectBench，并评测无监督与主动选择方法。在真实生态检测任务上的迁移实验进一步揭示该范式的机会与局限。
arxiv.reason: Agent 程序搜索与自动机器学习流程，兼有大规模基准，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
arxiv.abstract: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习扩散语言模型何时应当重新生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型的 remasking 能回溯已生成文本，但有效纠错取决于判断何时改、改哪里。在 Sudoku 上的诊断显示两处缺口：隐藏状态中的错误信息无法由 token 置信度可靠暴露，且在上下文不变时对孤立错误重新掩码往往会复现同一错误。为此提出 DiVR：一个以模型自身轨迹的最终正确性训练的验证器，用来预测部分生成的序列能否得到正确答案，进而决定何时重新生成整块内容、保留哪个候选，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 的五个推理基准上，DiVR 把微调生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提升到 43.4%，成本为贪心解码的 1.9–3.5 倍，低于耗用 3.8–7.4 倍的搜索基线；并可叠加 SFT 与强化学习后训练，也能迁移到 Dream 等其他生成器。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型属低分方向，但验证器驱动的 test-time 重生成有推理侧价值

arxiv.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
arxiv.titleZh: CoReMem：以内化成本与前瞻估值为核心，为连续编码任务设计的记忆机制
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体在持续演化的仓库上连续执行任务，并需要在下一个任务未知时写入记忆，因此要在未来收益与读写成本之间权衡。CoReMem 采用前瞻式片段估值：在同一继承仓库状态下，对比有无某条轨迹片段时下一任务的表现，据此构建以仓库位置和可执行检查（anchors）为核心的紧凑记忆；同时在 rollout 组内比较有无记忆时的 on-policy 价值，奖励优先保证成功、惩罚成功路径的步数，并把额外价值只归因到使用记忆锚点的步骤。在 ChainSWE 上，该方法把 27B 智能体的解决率从 21.0% 提升到 25.7%，步数减少 17%，包含记忆调用的缓存感知 token 减少 11%。
arxiv.reason: 编码 Agent 记忆加后训练，方法新颖，直接涉及 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
arxiv.abstract: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network's starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.
arxiv.titleZh: 将快速学习与神经网络中的组合结构联系起来:元学习参数空间中加性类比的证据
arxiv.summaryZh: 元学习过的网络能快速学会新函数，但其内部机制仍不清楚。该工作借鉴词向量的加性类比(king−man+woman≈queen)，把网络快速适应某个函数后全部参数拼成一个向量，检验不同函数的参数向量能否按符号关系相加减，并直接测试重组向量所定义的网络是否真的实现了目标函数。结果显示，这些相加减得到的参数向量无需任何训练即可实现对应函数，表明元学习调整了网络的起点，使后续学习沿系统性、有功能意义的轨迹展开，为归纳偏置提供了几何层面的解释。
arxiv.reason: 元学习参数空间加性结构，机制有趣但偏离 LLM 主线

arxiv.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
arxiv.abstract: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our work suggests two things. First, that energies are an extremely promising direction for training reasoning from data. Second, a caution against using trivially solvable benchmarks like Sudoku and Maze to test the scalability of looped reasoning techniques.
arxiv.titleZh: 经典能量模型学习推理的速度比循环模型快1,000倍
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环模型在 Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Unique 等推理谜题上表现亮眼，但不稳定、训练慢且参数与 FLOPs 开销大。作者复兴 80 年代 Hopfield-Tank 能量模型并提出 CRAM，通过对能量做下降求解，自带早停、算力随题目难度自适应、无需对求解器求导即可快速训练，权重可解释并学到谜题约束。在单张 GPU 上训练 42 ms 与 132 ms 后，CRAM 分别解出 99.996% 的 Sudoku-Extreme 与 100% 的 Maze-Unique 测试题，速度至少快 1,000 倍，并在同等最高准确率下推理 FLOPs 减少至少 282 倍。结果提示能量方法是从数据中学习推理的有前景方向，也警示 Sudoku、Maze 这类过于易解的基准不足以检验循环推理技术的可扩展性。
arxiv.reason: 关乎推理范式且质疑循环模型基准有效性，但非 LLM 工作

arxiv.title: Towards a Theory of Learnability via Debate
arxiv.abstract: Debate has been recently proposed as a training protocol that is hoped to produce more aligned models even as model capabilities scale. The idea is that the human, instead of providing supervision in the form of labels, judges a debate between two models that compete to prove the correctness of opposite labels. It can be shown that functions of a much higher computational complexity can be correctly judged in this way, compared to the complexity of functions that can be directly evaluated using a computationally weak evaluator. This suggests that perhaps debate can be used to teach very complicated functions to models. However, previous work has largely ignored the fact that this is a training protocol, and simply analyzes the game being played between the two debaters for a known judge. We take the first steps towards understanding the learning problem implicit within the protocol, by formulating it as an online learning problem. We show that once we formulate the learning problem precisely, there are cases where the best way to learn given access to a judge is different from running an adversarial debate. This motivates us to define a cooperative version of the protocol, whose learnability we characterize using a combinatorial dimension. We also consider the possibility of the human judge being fallible and occasionally judging the debate incorrectly. We show that a small number of errors in judgement can lead to a large error in learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 迈向基于辩论的可学习性理论
arxiv.summaryZh: 把辩论从“给定裁判下的对弈博弈”重新理解为训练协议本身：人类只评判两个模型的对辩，而不提供标签，据此将其中隐含的学习问题形式化为在线学习问题。分析表明，存在若干情形，在可访问裁判的条件下，最优学习方式并非运行对抗式辩论，由此提出协作式辩论协议，并用一个组合维度刻画其可学习性。进一步考虑人类裁判偶发出错的情况，结果显示少量判断错误即可导致学习误差显著放大。该工作为可扩展监督中的辩论式训练给出了学习理论层面的刻画与边界。
arxiv.reason: 辩论式可扩展监督的学习理论刻画，贴合对齐与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.
arxiv.comment: Project page, code and data: https://goals.baulab.info/
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 中的目标编码
arxiv.summaryZh: 探究LLM内部是否编码「先于行动、并能经多条执行路径实现」的目标：搭建含多个子任务的编程场景，在一小簇注意力头的输出中定位到下一个子目标的编码，并能用自然语言直接解码模型的后续动作（如「我在检查单词是否为回文」）。因果干预显示该编码对下一步动作有因果作用且可迁移——移植到另一门编程语言后，同一操作以不同token序列实现。模型能在整个执行过程中维持该编码，作者据此提出非循环式目标寻求（NRGS）解释：模型反复从任务说明重读目标、与上下文中的进度比对，只推进剩余部分，并用针对性因果干预验证该预测。
arxiv.reason: 机制可解释性揭示目标表征，与Agent规划、Agentic RL直接相关

arxiv.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
arxiv.abstract: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
arxiv.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code available at https://github.com/WangHaoZhe/metal-sandbox and https://github.com/WangHaoZhe/harbor
arxiv.titleZh: Metal Sandbox：为 Apple Silicon 上的 GPU 编码智能体提供隔离执行与命令调度
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向在 Apple Silicon 上生成 Metal kernel 的编码智能体，解决 rollout 过程中模型请求、开发命令与 GPU 执行交替进行而导致 GPU 大量空闲的问题。Metal Sandbox 为每个智能体实例提供受限的文件访问与原生命令执行环境，并在互联的多台 Mac 之间做命令级调度：并行命令可同时运行，串行命令在每个节点上共享一个执行槽，符合条件的等待命令可迁移到空闲 Mac，并把结果回传给原智能体；与 Harbor 集成支持任务执行、自动验证与 rollout 采集。在四台 Mac mini M4 上的受控实验中，集中需求下命令吞吐提升 1.68×–2.05×；16 条静态智能体轨迹估算每节点四会话相对单会话可持续吞吐提升 2.14×；动态调度回放使平均工具等待降低 18.8%、批次耗时降低 22.3%。该工作为本地 GPU 编码智能体的基础设施与调度提供了可复用的开源方案。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体执行与调度基础设施，贴近 Agent 方向但非模型层创新

arxiv.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向单边可验证奖励的仅负向策略优化
arxiv.summaryZh: RLVR通常依赖能可靠判定答案正误的验证器，但现实中往往只有能证伪失败的廉价检查，即单边可验证性（OSV）：负例是可信反例，正例仅为未被证伪的候选，可能含大量假正。NOPO将已验证正例视为无标签数据，仅通过抑制可信负例来更新策略，由reference-relative负向抑制损失与组级adapter组成，后者按未证伪响应比例缩放更新步长。在单元测试、约束检查与LLM自验证三类验证器下，oracle奖励不可用时，NOPO在代码、逻辑、数学基准上的pass@k超过基线，且收益在推理时扩展与跨基准迁移下依然保持。
arxiv.reason: RLVR新设定下的仅负例优化方法，选题与后训练方向直接契合

arxiv.title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
arxiv.abstract: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.
arxiv.titleZh: 合成走私：在 LLM 输出中恶意隐藏推断出的个人属性
arxiv.summaryZh: 常规的求助式对话会让模型接触到足以推断用户性别、年龄段等敏感属性的线索，这些推断结果可被隐写编码进看似无害的生成文本，用户随后在分享邮件、社交媒体帖子时无意中把信息传出，监听渠道的对手即可还原。为验证该威胁，作者训练了两个开放权重模型，先从对话线索推断性别与年龄段标签，再用不可见字符或特定选词把预测编码进输出。结果显示，即使用户分享的模型产物本身不直接连接对手，也能成为传递个人推断的隐蔽信道。这一威胁模型提示：输出侧水印与隐写检测、分享前的输出净化，应成为 LLM 隐私防护的一环。
arxiv.reason: LLM 隐私与隐写隐蔽信道，与后训练、Agent 主线距离较远

arxiv.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
arxiv.abstract: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. Further analysis identifies a key bottleneck: agents struggle to acquire and translate relevant evidence into valid decisions and maintain their correctness as the world evolves. By releasing LiveGeo together with its GeoWorld platform, we aim to provide the community with a flexible and extensible infrastructure for studying the next generation of agents capable of reliable action in evolving geographic worlds.
arxiv.titleZh: LiveGeo：在持续演化的世界中评测地理 Agent 的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有评测多在固定地理状态下做推理与规划的问题，构建了 GeoWorld——基于真实地理结构、允许外部世界状态按自身时间进程演化并保留可验证状态历史的环境平台，并在其上提出 LiveGeo 基准。任务要求 Agent 主动获取任务相关信息、核验支撑既往决策的证据是否仍然有效，并在必要时修订计划。结果显示前沿 LLM 在静态任务上已显吃力且无一模型全面领先，静态表现强并不能保证动态可靠性；关键瓶颈在于 Agent 难以把相关证据转化为有效决策，并在世界演化中维持其正确性。
arxiv.reason: Agent 在动态演化环境中的决策与证据校验基准，命中 Agent 与环境合成方向

arxiv.title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
arxiv.abstract: Modern automated heuristic discovery (AHD) systems increasingly rival hand-crafted heuristics by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively mutate and refine solutions. A natural assumption is that more powerful and more expensive models consistently yield better heuristics. We challenge this empirically: across multiple NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, we find no consistent advantage for larger, costlier models. This raises a deeper question: given a pool of LLMs spanning frontier and freely hosted or open-weight models, how should one adaptively select which model to invoke at each step of the search? The challenge is non-trivial. The optimal LLM may shift over the course of a run, and because one LLM's output seeds the context for subsequent calls, each model's reward signal is non-stationary and entangled across the heuristic population, thus violating the independence assumptions of classical online decision-making settings. We address this through Ballad (Bandit-based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery), an online bandit algorithm that learns to orchestrate a pool of LLMs into an ensemble that matches or exceeds what any soloist LLM achieves alone. This orchestration is powered by an LLM selection policy that favors rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable averages, a DAG-based credit propagation mechanism through the genealogy of the heuristic population, and discounting of stale observations to remain attuned to each model's current utility. Across five NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems and a pool of four models of varying capability and cost, Ballad not only matches the best individual LLM in hindsight but, in several cases, surpasses every individual model while reducing API cost by up to 65.6% relative to always using the strongest model.
arxiv.titleZh: Ballad：基于Bandit的LLM路由，用于自动启发式发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 实验表明更大更贵的LLM在自动启发式发现中并无稳定优势，问题于是变成：在混合前沿与开源模型的模型池中，如何逐步自适应地选择调用哪个模型。该问题的难点在于最优模型会随搜索进程漂移，且一个模型的输出会成为后续调用的上下文，使各模型奖励信号非平稳并在启发式种群间纠缠，破坏经典在线决策的独立性假设。Ballad用在线Bandit算法编排模型池：选择策略偏好稀有但高分的启发式而非稳定均值，按启发式族谱的DAG做信用回传，并对陈旧观测打折以跟踪模型当前效用。在5个NP-hard组合优化问题、4个不同能力与成本的模型上，它匹配事后最优的单模型，多处超越所有单模型，同时相比始终调用最强模型降低API成本最多65.6%。
arxiv.reason: LLM路由与模型池编排，兼跨成本效率与自动搜索，方法扎实

arxiv.title: Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings. Building upon recent set theoretic formalizations of al sabr wa al Taqsim that extract minimal operational rules as simple Horn clause logical programs, this work proves that the semantics of closed Fiqh chapters collapse completely to deterministic Finite State Automata (FSA). We establish a formal computational hierarchy, demonstrating that restricting formalization to finite propositional Horn theories guarantees decidability and constant time (O(1)) verdict extraction after offline compilation. The framework formally proves that hierarchical compositions of sub-chapter FSAs preserve this O(1) complexity, and that temporal juristic requirements, such as Tartib (order), are deterministically flattened into static ontological states, preserving the memoryless property of the automaton. To generate human-readable juristic summaries, Al Ghasali incorporates Large Language Models (LLMs) via an architecture where the deterministic FSA strictly controls the probabilistic LLM. Crucially, the paper formulates sufficient design safety conditions for this FSA LLM integration, ensuring strict adherence to the epistemological boundaries of Usul al Fiqh. To neutralize the risk of LLM hallucination, the system employs a Grammar Guided Constrained Decoding mechanism. We formally define the mapping function that dynamically constructs unambiguous right linear grammars from the FSA execution history. The paper mathematically proves that this architecture, augmented by a Bounded Neutral Lexicon and Valence Locking, guarantees the absolute absence of Decisional Hallucination, Juristic Factual Hallucination, and Semantic Inversion reducing the LLM to a pure linguistic transformer of deterministic juristic facts
arxiv.titleZh: Al-Ghasali:一个通过有限状态自动机与大语言模型模拟伊斯兰教法裁决的计算框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对伊斯兰教法(Fiqh)裁决的形式化与模拟，在既有集合论形式化基础上证明闭合教法章节的语义可完全归约为确定性有限状态自动机(FSA)，并给出计算层级:限定为有限命题Horn理论后，离线编译即可实现O(1)裁决抽取，子章节FSA的层级组合与Tartib等时序要求均保持该复杂度。系统由确定性FSA严格控制LLM生成，配合由执行历史动态构造右线性文法的约束解码、有界中性词表与效价锁定，数学证明可排除决策性幻觉、教法事实幻觉与语义反转，使LLM退化为确定性事实的语言转换器。其意义在于提供一条“符号控制器+LLM语言化”的可证明安全路线，但落地场景限于教法领域。
arxiv.reason: 教法垂直应用，仅约束解码与LLM可靠性略沾边

arxiv.title: Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation
arxiv.abstract: Many hypotheses compete to explain the successes of knowledge distillation. To help address this, we propose and analyze a mathematical model of distillation, which suggests that distillation's performance comes not from obtaining better models but from easier to optimize landscapes. For generalized linear models trained with stochastic gradient descent, we prove that distillation fits performant student models asymptotically more quickly than non-distilled models. In rank-1 matrix approximation, we characterize conditions on the target matrix under which gradient descent with distillation converges strictly faster than training on the supervised objective. The theory helps delineate the ways distillation provides benefits (i.e., in optimization speed, not in generalization), and experiments on real datasets corroborate the theoretical predictions.
arxiv.titleZh: 知识蒸馏的两个数学模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对「知识蒸馏为何有效」这一问题以及多种假说并存的现状，提出并分析两个数学模型，论证蒸馏的收益来自更易优化的损失地形，而不是更好的模型。对使用随机梯度下降训练的广义线性模型，证明蒸馏以渐近更快的速度拟合出有效的学生模型；在秩1矩阵近似中，刻画目标矩阵在何种条件下时，带蒸馏的梯度下降严格快于在监督目标上训练。真实数据集上的实验验证了理论预测，明确指出蒸馏的优势在于优化速度，而非泛化。
arxiv.reason: 蒸馏理论刻画，命中关注方向但偏纯理论，缺乏 LLM 规模验证

arxiv.title: Sheaf-Inspired Structured Scoring Extensions of LightGCN for Collaborative Filtering
arxiv.abstract: Graph-based collaborative filtering learns user and item representations by propagating embeddings over a user--item interaction graph. We investigate a modular, sheaf-inspired scoring extension placed on top of a three-layer LightGCN backbone. The motivation comes from cellular sheaves, where local vector spaces are related by linear restriction maps; here, this idea motivates structured, pair-dependent transformations of user and item embeddings rather than a change to graph propagation. We compare the identity inner-product scorer, diagonal, rank-one low-rank, and full matrix residual scorers, and a parameter-matched residual MLP baseline (\texttt{mlp\_full}) on Amazon-Book, Gowalla, MovieLens-1M, and Yelp2018. We report ranking quality and catalog coverage at cutoffs 10 and 20. The selected structured variants show modest, dataset-dependent changes in ranking quality and sometimes substantial changes in coverage. Our method is inspired by sheaf geometry but does not construct a cellular sheaf or implement sheaf-Laplacian diffusion; the experiments therefore do not establish a causal benefit from sheaf geometry itself.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向协同过滤的 LightGCN 层（sheaf）启发式结构化打分扩展
arxiv.summaryZh: 在协同过滤中，图神经推荐模型通常用内积作为用户与物品的打分器；该工作在三层 LightGCN 骨干之上加入模块化的层（sheaf）启发式打分扩展，借鉴胞腔层中局部向量空间之间由线性限制映射关联的思路，用与用户—物品对相关的结构化变换替代单纯的恒等内积，并且不改动图传播过程。实验比较了恒等内积、对角、秩一低秩、全矩阵残差四种打分器，以及参数匹配的残差 MLP 基线，在 Amazon-Book、Gowalla、MovieLens-1M 与 Yelp2018 上报告 cutoff 10 与 20 的排序质量和目录覆盖率。结构化变体带来的排序质量变化有限且依赖具体数据集，覆盖率则有时出现较大波动；由于并未真正构造胞腔层或实现 sheaf-Laplacian 扩散，实验无法证明层几何本身带来因果收益。
arxiv.reason: 图协同过滤打分器改进，与 LLM 及后训练、Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Introducing Feedback Delays to Non-Delayed Adversarial MDPs: Optimal $\sqrt S$ and $\sqrt K$ Dependencies in Tabular and Linear AMDPs
arxiv.abstract: We study regret minimization in episodic Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (AMDPs) with unknown transitions and bandit feedback. In tabular AMDPs with $S$ states, $A$ actions, and horizon $H$, the best known $K$-episode regret is $\tilde O(HS\sqrt{AK})$, whose $\sqrt S$ gap to the $Ω(H\sqrt{SAK})$ lower bound has long remained open. In linear AMDPs with $d$-dimensional features, after a five-year line of improvements starting from $K^{14/15}$, computationally efficient algorithms without a simulator or exploratory assumptions still only attain $\tilde O(K^{3/4})$ regret. A common challenge in both settings is to estimate the Q-function of a changing policy: past data comes from earlier policies that differ from (and are correlated with) the current one, while freezing the policy for future episodes worsens the dependency on $K$. We instead propose a general technique called introduced feedback delays: we estimate the Q-function of the policy using future episodes while still updating the policy, as if the feedback were delayed. While feedback delays are usually an obstacle imposed by the environment, here they are introduced voluntarily and, perhaps surprisingly, come at no extra cost. We develop Geometric Resampling with Rejection (GRR) to account for policy changes during the delay, and threshold the visitation probabilities to avoid long delays on rarely visited state-action pairs. With this unified technique, our policy optimization algorithms achieve, with high probability, $\tilde O(\text{poly}(H)\sqrt{SAK})$ regret in tabular AMDPs, resolving the open problem; and $\tilde O(\text{poly}(d,H)\sqrt K)$ regret in linear AMDPs, giving the first efficient algorithm optimal in $K$. They also naturally extend to delayed AMDPs with a total feedback delay $\mathfrak D$, yielding the first bounds optimal in $S$ and $\mathfrak D$ (tabular) and in $K$ and $\mathfrak D$ (linear).
arxiv.titleZh: 为无延迟对抗性 MDP 引入反馈延迟:表格与线性 AMDP 中最优的 √S 与 √K 依赖
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究未知转移、bandit 反馈的 episodic 对抗性 MDP(AMDP)的 regret 最小化，表格情形与下界长期相差 √S，线性情形的高效算法也仅达 Õ(K^{3/4})。难点在于估计不断变化的策略的 Q 函数:历史数据来自与当前策略相关但不同的旧策略。提出主动引入反馈延迟的通用技术，用未来 episode 的数据估计当前策略的 Q 函数，同时继续更新策略;并用 Geometric Resampling with Rejection 处理延迟期间的策略变化，对访问概率设阈值以避免稀有状态-动作对上的长延迟。由此在表格 AMDP 取得高概率 Õ(poly(H)√(SAK)) regret，闭合该开放问题;线性 AMDP 取得 Õ(poly(d,H)√K)，为首个对 K 最优的高效算法，并扩展到总延迟 𝔇 的延迟 AMDP。
arxiv.reason: 纯 RL 理论 regret 分析，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Physically Interpretable Basin Selection in Discrete-Variable Origami Design
arxiv.abstract: Automatic differentiation has enabled rapid progress on continuous-variable mechanical design problems, but gradient-based optimization still struggles with discrete variables. The standard approach is to optimize using a continuous relaxation of the choices, then commit to the nearest discrete design at the end. Why this procedure selects unfavorable basins is poorly understood. Here, we introduce a practical, interpretable design problem inspired by origami, in which automatic differentiation is used to design shapes with a target functional behavior. Each origami sheet has a fixed geometry, and a bilevel optimization framework tunes which one of four discrete hinge types to place at each fold. Baseline gradient-based design settles into basins with a large discretization gap: relaxed optimization solves 97% of runs, but the final, discrete solutions succeed only half the time. We find that the gap can be relieved with a surprisingly simple modification. An initialization prior uniformly biased toward the stiff, flat hinge option boosts the final solve fraction from 49% to 69%. Applying the prior adds no additional compute and leaves the optimization process unchanged. Compared to the baseline, sheets produced with the prior have greater geometric compatibility and mechanical stiffness. Directly penalizing frustration and floppiness in the outer loss function produces an even greater improvement than the prior does, raising the solve fraction to 78% and indicating that these properties help distinguish the unfavorable basins. Our results demonstrate that loss landscapes for mechanical design can have physically meaningful basins that are not robust to discretization and cause solves to fail. Targeting these basins' physical signatures, even with just an initialization bias, helps avoid them.
arxiv.titleZh: 离散变量折纸设计中物理可解释的优化盆地选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 离散变量机械设计常先用连续松弛优化、最后取最近离散解，但该流程为何落入不利盆地尚不清楚。构造固定几何的折纸设计问题，用双层优化为每个折痕在四种离散铰链中选择，并以外层损失直接惩罚挫败与松垮。基线松弛优化在97%的运行中成功，最终离散解仅49%成功；将初始化均匀偏向刚性平坦铰链可把成功率提升到69%，直接惩罚则提升到78%，且所得折纸几何兼容性与机械刚度更好。结果表明机械设计损失景观存在物理可解释但对离散化不鲁棒的盆地。
arxiv.reason: 机械折纸设计，与LLM无关，属低分方向

arxiv.title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
arxiv.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of $λ=0.01$ lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least $16$ relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most $0.02$ in all but one model-rank comparison. Single-task and scheduling experiments further show that the balance between learning and retention depends on the configuration. We also observe that several LoRA variants in the literature also suffer from the identified capacity issue, and our approach provides a complementary axis of improvement to LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These results suggest that effective rank is not only a post-hoc diagnostic of adapter quality, but a trainable objective for improving the learning-forgetting frontier. Our code is available at https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization
arxiv.titleZh: 最大化 LoRA 适配器的容量利用率以缓解学习—遗忘权衡
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准 LoRA 适配器的有效秩远低于配置秩，更新能量分布受限，这是 LoRA 在学习与遗忘之间难以兼顾的潜在原因之一。为此，在以语言建模损失为基础的目标上加入一个简洁、稳定、可微且无需 SVD 的 Rényi-2 有效秩正则项，并给出容量最大化与范数受限更新之间的联系。在三个模型的混合域秩扫描中，当惩罚权重 λ=0.01 时，所有测试的秩不低于 16 的设置下平均 Wiki 困惑度都低于无惩罚 LoRA，多数模型—秩组合的训练困惑度提升或增幅不超过 0.02。该工作把有效秩从诊断指标变为可训练目标，为 LoRA 及同类参数高效微调提供了一条互补的改进方向。
arxiv.reason: LoRA 后训练改进，方法简洁有效，属高分方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Cortex-FL: Agent-Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning
arxiv.abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data. However, identifying collaborators, preparing training tasks, and coordinating execution and incentives hinder its practical adoption by organizations without specialized expertise. We present Cortex-FL, an agent-native FL system that enables users to express learning objectives in natural language and delegate the collaboration required to train a model. Agents translate these objectives into shared tasks, discover collaborators, and negotiate participation agreements, connecting collaboration formation with distributed training and incentive management. The architecture separates agent coordination from local execution authority, allowing owners to delegate coordination while retaining control over their data, computation, and financial commitments. We demonstrate the complete workflow on a four-node deployment, in which a model requested in natural language proceeds through collaboration formation, contract-governed training, verified model delivery, and x402 settlement on a blockchain testnet.
arxiv.titleZh: Cortex-FL:面向联邦学习的智能体中介协作
arxiv.summaryZh: 联邦学习要求数据所有者自行完成寻找合作方、准备训练任务、协调执行与结算激励等繁琐工作，缺乏专业知识的企业难以落地。Cortex-FL把这一切交给智能体:用户用自然语言表达学习目标，智能体将其转译为共享任务、发现合作者并协商参与协议，把协作组建与分布式训练、激励机制打通;架构上将智能体协调与本地执行权分离，所有者可委托协调但仍掌控数据、算力与资金承诺。作者在四节点部署上跑通完整流程——自然语言请求的模型依次完成协作组建、合约约束训练、模型交付验证与区块链测试网上的x402结算。
arxiv.reason: 联邦学习+智能体编排，偏系统集成，与后训练/Agent核心方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
arxiv.abstract: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length.
