Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and models: https://github.com/UmarGit/coffee-llm
arxiv.titleZh: 解析成功、貌似合理、实则错误:输出格式控制小模型语义解析中的静默错误
arxiv.summaryZh: 小模型解析器输出格式合法但语义错误的树时会静默失败，下游无从察觉;该工作检验输出格式这一自由设计选择是否控制此类错误的发生率。在PIZZA点单基准上以LoRA微调Qwen3.5-0.8B与LFM2.5-350M，比较同一目标树的六种无损编码(每单44.3至10.9个token)，并设等长而表层形式不同的对照，共300次运行配分层bootstrap与Holm校正。单纯缩短从不奏效，用普通词书写目标最有效:Qwen精确匹配87.5%对原生s-expression的85.8%,token少4.1倍，静默错误率降2.3倍，LFM2降1.8倍。模型还学会拒识菜单外输入(95.9%–99.0%)，代价是2.1%–10.1%真实礼貌订单被误拒。
arxiv.reason: 小模型结构化输出格式的实证研究，擦边后训练与评测可靠性

arxiv.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
arxiv.abstract: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
arxiv.titleZh: Actor、Judge还是Teacher?理解长程智能体中的决策模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 决策模型能输出带类型的答案(如各选项概率)，因此同一模型既可充当执行动作的actor，也可评估已执行的动作，或为强化学习策略逐动作打分充当teacher。已有工作多以actor视角衡量其价值，本文追问「行动表现差的模型是否仍能教得好」:在ALFWorld上比较三个决策模型与三个通用LLM作为actor和judge的表现，并以JEV作teacher在ALFWorld与WebShop上训练策略。结果显示，六个模型作为actor时都会被更易达成的子目标吸引而偏离必须先完成的子目标，但作为看到完整轨迹的judge却能正确归因这些前置步骤;且以「该动作是否有帮助」而非「任务是否会成功」提问，能有效区分有用与无用动作。作为teacher,JEV把Qwen2.5-1.5B策略的GRPO成功率从72.8%提升到82.9%(ALFWorld)、从56.8%提升到71.4%(WebShop)，说明事后评判能揭示行动时需预判的后果，为Agentic RL中的奖励与教师信号设计提供了新思路。
arxiv.reason: 决策模型作judge/teacher服务Agentic RL与奖励设计，直接命中Agent方向

arxiv.title: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
arxiv.abstract: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.
arxiv.titleZh: 时间中的对称性:线性循环记忆的表示理论
arxiv.summaryZh: 用表示论刻画线性循环模型(SSM)的状态追踪能力:状态更新定义了输入序列幺半群的线性表示，SSM在所有序列长度上都能追踪某个群，当且仅当该群是其转移矩阵所生成群的商群。由此推出实值与复值对角SSM只能追踪交换群，而任何能追踪非交换群的SSM，其转移矩阵必须在实数、复数、四元数上分裂为独立分块。据此提出HyperSSM，加入四元数通道并保持线性时间推理与并行训练;仅用最终答案监督，以至多5个状态数精确求解state-tracking基准中的群任务，包括32个生成元的S5(此前SSM仅达随机水平)，并泛化到训练长度25倍的序列。理论还使线性循环的学得权重可直接解读，作者据此恢复了真实陀螺仪标定、非理想量子门旋转与蛋白质骨架几何。
arxiv.reason: SSM表示理论加四元数新架构，命中架构与表达能力方向

arxiv.title: Cited but Unused: Parametric Provenance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems attach citations to attribute claims to their sources. These citations frequently misstate provenance, and standard verification cannot detect this. We measure provenance by counterfactual value substitution: a fact in the retrieved passages is replaced with a false variant and the model re-queried. We find that across five sizes of one model family and a second comparator family, 1.2% to 15.7% of citable claims derive from parametric memory rather than the retrieved context. At the most conservative substitution distance these figures are 4.6% and 8.5% on the two models we tested at it, with the rate rising with model size within a family. We further find that natural language inference verification, the standard approach, gives results indistinguishable from chance across models, even when restricted to the cited passage. We determine that the cause is structural: a model answering from memory selects a citation that agrees with its output. Comparing ten attribution methods on identical claims, the contrast between the model's distribution with and without context best separates provenance. Acting on that signal does not improve provenance honesty at these base rates. The resulting detector is hence still not accurate enough to act on: it measures what the model knew rather than what it used, and separating those remains the open problem.
arxiv.titleZh: 被引用却未被使用:检索增强生成中的参数化来源
arxiv.summaryZh: RAG 系统用引用把论断归属到检索来源，但这种引用常错标来源，而标准验证手段检测不出。工作以反事实值替换度量来源:把检索段落中的事实换成错误变体后重新提问，在某一模型族的五个规模与第二个对照模型族上测得 1.2%–15.7% 的可引用论断实际来自参数记忆，在最保守的替换距离下两个受测模型分别为 4.6% 与 8.5%，且该比例随模型规模上升。自然语言推理验证这一标准做法在各模型上甚至限定在被引段落内也仅与随机猜测无异，原因是结构性的:从记忆作答的模型会挑一个与自身输出相符的引用。在相同论断上比较十种归因方法，有无上下文时模型分布的对比最能区分来源，但按该信号干预并不能提升来源诚实度，检测器测到的是模型「知道什么」而非「用了什么」。
arxiv.reason: RAG 引用溯源的可验证评测，方法学扎实、结论有分量

arxiv.title: AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
arxiv.abstract: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on datasets that each vary one design family in one flow domain. Such datasets cannot test the least that an aerodynamic foundation model must do: predict CFD-quality incompressible flow in seconds for new shapes in new enclosures. On DrivAerML, larger models and longer training barely lower Transolver's error; doubling the training cases cuts it by about 12% up to 400 cases, exhausting the dataset. We introduce AeroZoo, a benchmark and training corpus of 3,815 time-mean solutions to the unsteady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) equations with a transition model, across seven geometry families, eight enclosure configurations and Reynolds numbers from $10^3$ to $10^8$. Each sample poses a well-posed PDE problem in the form a solver receives it: the boundary meshes grouped by condition type, the prescribed values and the fluid properties. The 2,816 samples with a stable time mean form the canonical benchmark: two tasks, engineering metrics and 22 frozen splits, disjoint in geometry, that hold out geometry families, enclosures, boundary-condition layouts and Reynolds ranges. On the random split, boundary-condition tokens cut GeoTransolver's median velocity error from 76.9% to 8.4% of the inlet speed in single-seed runs (uniform inlet flow: 11.0%). ISLA, a transformer for boundary-driven PDEs, reaches 5.3% over four seeds, about 4 times the change from a finer mesh. On the same test samples, a held-out geometry family barely changes ISLA's error relative to uniform flow, and a held-out enclosure or boundary-condition layout raises it 2.4 to 9.2 times. The data and the scoring code will be released.
arxiv.comment: 35 pages, 13 figures, 23 tables. Lead authors: Peter Sharpe and Carmelo Gonzales. Companion paper to "ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs" (Sharpe, 2026). Dataset to be published shortly at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/AeroZoo
arxiv.titleZh: AeroZoo：面向空气动力学基础模型的良定流动问题基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 CFD 神经代理数据集只变化单一设计族与单一流场，无法检验基础模型对新外形、新外罩秒级给出 CFD 级不可压流预测的能力。AeroZoo 收录 3815 个带转捩模型的 URANS 时均解，覆盖 7 个几何族、8 种外罩与 Re 从 10^3 到 10^8，按求解器输入形式给出分类边界网格、给定值与流体属性，2816 个稳定样本构成含 22 个几何不相交冻结划分的基准。随机划分上边界条件 token 使 GeoTransolver 中位速度误差从入口速度的 76.9% 降至 8.4%，ISLA 四种子达 5.3%；留出几何族几乎不增误差，留出外罩或边界条件布局则升高 2.4 到 9.2 倍。
arxiv.reason: CFD/PDE 物理仿真基准，仅因用 Transformer 与 LLM 方向擦边

arxiv.title: Enhancing Preference Detection using Eye Movement Cascade and Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
arxiv.abstract: Understanding how visual attention influences human preference formation is a fundamental problem in consumer behavior and cognitive science. In this work, we investigate how eye movement patterns can be used to predict preference decisions when subjects compare two alternatives. To address this problem, we analyze an eye-tracking dataset, where subjects view pairs of face images and their gaze behavior is recorded throughout the decision process. We model this problem using multiple machine learning classifiers and apply the Multi-layer Combinatorial Fusion (MCF) framework to iteratively combine diverse models. The MCF framework expands models to a large pool of model fusions and then reduces them based on cognitive diversity, repeating this process across layers until diversity diminishes. Experimental results show that MCF significantly improves performance over individual models. The best single model achieves a Pre@k of 0.90, which is improved to 0.9143 after the first layer of MCF, and further increased to 0.9286 in the second layer. This progression demonstrates that the second layer not only surpasses the performance of the first layer but also outperforms the best individual model, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging diversity through multi-layer fusion.
arxiv.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 26th Annual International Conference of the Global Business and Technology Association (GBATA), 2026, pp. 969-980
arxiv.titleZh: 利用眼动级联与多层组合融合增强偏好检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对视觉注意如何影响偏好形成这一问题，该工作利用受试者成对比较人脸图像时的眼动轨迹数据，用多个机器学习分类器预测其偏好选择。方法上采用多层组合融合(MCF)框架:先把模型扩展为大规模融合池，再依据认知多样性剪枝，逐层重复直至多样性衰减。结果显示，最佳单模型Pre@k为0.90，经第一层融合升至0.9143，第二层进一步达0.9286，超过最佳单模型。该结果说明融合多样性可提升基于眼动的偏好预测，适用于消费者行为与认知建模场景。
arxiv.reason: 眼动与认知科学交叉的偏好预测，与LLM方向无关

arxiv.title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
arxiv.abstract: We study data poisoning attacks on logistic regression with $\ell_2$-regularization, where an attacker chooses the features of a fixed number of injected observations with prescribed labels to maximize the logistic loss on the clean training data. Strong convexity of the defender's problem yields an exact reformulation through its first-order optimality conditions. Using convex conjugacy of the softplus function, we replace the sigmoid relations by a single convex optimality-gap inequality and express the attacker's objective as a concave function. A change of variables makes the stationarity condition affine, leaving bounded bilinear equalities as the only nonconvex constraints. We derive finite bounds on all variables involved in these equalities, including a global bound on the coefficient norm and tighter bounds obtained by preprocessing based on convex optimization. Experiments on eight binary classification datasets evaluate attack effectiveness and compare the two reformulations when solved with \textsf{SCIP}. Attacks obtained by local optimization degrade predictive performance on most datasets, while the convex-analytic formulation produces substantially stronger reported dual bounds within a fixed time limit.
arxiv.titleZh: 逻辑回归中毒攻击的凸分析重构
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对ℓ2正则化逻辑回归的数据中毒攻击，攻击者需在注入样本的特征上求解非凸双层问题。利用防御方问题的强凸性，由一阶最优性条件得到精确重构；再借助softplus的凸共轭把sigmoid关系替换为单一凸最优性间隙不等式，使攻击目标成为凹函数，经变量替换让平稳性条件变为仿射，只留下有界双线性等式作为非凸约束，并对所有变量给出有限界（含系数范数的全局界与凸优化预处理得到的更紧界）。在八个二分类数据集上，局部优化得到的攻击在多数数据集上降低了模型预测性能，而凸分析重构在固定时限内给出了显著更强的对偶界。
arxiv.reason: 经典凸优化下的逻辑回归中毒攻击重构，与LLM方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs
arxiv.abstract: A foundational principle of physics is that all coordinate systems are equally valid: the behavior of a PDE-governed system does not depend on the origin or orientation of the frame, nor on the units or mesh used to write it down, and neither should a surrogate model. Yet the neural surrogates with the lowest errors on today's aerodynamics benchmarks lack these invariances and fail under simple transformations of the same problem: for models trained on PDEs of cars in one pose (i.e., translation and rotation) and from one mesher, rotating the full PDE raises the surface-pressure error from 4% to more than 100%, and re-sampling its boundary raises it to about 30%. We introduce ISLA (Invariant Slice Attention), a slice-attention transformer for steady, boundary-driven PDEs in which no learned operation receives a coordinate and every sum over the boundary is a quadrature. Positions enter only as distances and relative angles to learned slice anchors, lengths are measured in a unit computed from the boundary, and interior points query the boundary through a tree-accelerated learned kernel without influencing one another. With every boundary cell a token and an exact boundary read, ISLA is equivariant to rigid motions and reflections, invariant to the units of its declared data, and consistent under mesh refinement, while at every setting each query is independent of all other queries. On AeroZoo, 2,816 flows that vary in shape, size, speed, and boundary conditions, its mean reference-scaled velocity and pressure errors are at least 3.1 and 3.3 times lower than any baseline's. On AirfRANS its errors are second only to those of a boundary-integral model (GLOBE) and at least 1.6 times lower than those of Transolver and GeoTransolver.
arxiv.comment: 48 pages, 14 figures, 26 tables. Companion paper to "AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics" (Sharpe et al., 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: ISLA:面向边界驱动 PDE 的无坐标、测度加权 Transformer
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有气动代理模型缺乏物理不变性:把单一姿态训练的汽车 PDE 旋转后，表面压力误差从 4% 升到 100% 以上，边界重采样后升至约 30%。ISLA 是面向稳态边界驱动 PDE 的切片注意力 Transformer:任何学习操作都不接收坐标，边界求和一律以求积实现，位置仅以到学习切片锚点的距离与相对角进入，长度用以边界导出的单位度量，内部点经树加速的学习核独立查询边界而不互相影响。模型对刚体运动与反射等变、对数据单位不变、网格细化下保持一致。在含 2816 个流动的 AeroZoo 上，其速度与压力平均误差比所有基线低至少 3.1 与 3.3 倍;在 AirfRANS 下次于边界积分模型 GLOBE，比 Transolver、GeoTransolver 低至少 1.6 倍。
arxiv.reason: 无坐标切片注意力有新意，但主战场是气动 PDE 代理，偏离 LLM 方向

arxiv.title: Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data
arxiv.abstract: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury. Standard reinforcement learning can propose risky, out-of-distribution actions, while imitation learning is limited to reproducing clinician behavior. We introduce Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration (FQI-SC), an offline reinforcement learning framework that cautiously improves upon expert behavior by restricting optimization to empirically supported state-action pairs and defaulting to the clinician baseline in low-data regions. On 78 pediatric trajectories totaling over 6,000 hours of clinical data, we evaluate our framework using Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) and a behavioral disagreement. Additionally, we formalize the performance-safety trade-off by introducing a unified Balance Score ($S(π)$). Our empirical evaluation shows that support-constrained policy improves the Balance Score by 38\% relative to FQI, improves estimated value by 1.28 FQE units over imitation learning, and reduces disagreement with clinician actions by 71\% relative to FQI.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向有限临床数据的儿童 ECMO 支撑约束离线策略改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 儿科 ECMO 管理需在短期生理稳定与长期神经损伤防控之间取得平衡，而标准强化学习容易给出有风险、分布外动作，模仿学习又只能复现临床医生行为。为此提出 Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration（FQI-SC），把优化限制在有经验支撑的状态-动作对上，低数据区域默认回退到临床基线，并引入统一的 Balance Score 刻画性能与安全的权衡。在 78 条儿科轨迹、逾 6000 小时临床数据上，FQI-SC 的 Balance Score 相比 FQI 提升 38%，估计价值比模仿学习高 1.28 个 FQE 单位，与医生动作的分歧相比 FQI 降低 71%。该工作属于离线 RL 在重症临床决策中的应用。
arxiv.reason: 医疗重症临床离线 RL 应用，与 LLM 后训练方向无交集

arxiv.title: Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
arxiv.abstract: Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol. Small errors in configuration, data partitioning, aggregation, randomness, evaluation, or checkpoint recovery may therefore affect a comparison without causing the program to fail. We present FedBrew, a research codebase for controlled and reproducible federated learning experiments. Its focus is controlled simulation with checks of specified conditions of the intended experimental protocol. FedBrew uses configuration checks, identifiable client data partitions, checkpoint recovery checks, self-describing run records, and development-time checks of scientific conditions. These checks assess, for example, whether client partitions are disjoint and exhaustive and aggregation weights match the prescribed rule; numerical and recovery checks examine non-finite client model states and interrupted runs. The same structure also provides clear extension points and automated checks for new algorithms, datasets, models, and tasks, whether they are added by researchers or AI coding agents. FedBrew therefore supports reproducible and inspectable FL experiments through checks of specified software and scientific conditions and the run records associated with reported results.
arxiv.titleZh: 忠于实验协议的联邦学习：面向实践者与 Agent 开发的科学检查
arxiv.summaryZh: 联邦学习实验即使实现偏离既定协议，也常产出看似合理的结果：配置、数据划分、聚合、随机性、评估或断点恢复中的细微错误不会让程序报错。FedBrew 以受控仿真为核心，提供配置检查、可识别的客户端数据划分、断点恢复检查、自描述运行记录，以及开发期对科学条件的自动核验，例如客户端分片是否互斥且完备、聚合权重是否符合规定规则、客户端模型是否出现非有限数值、中断运行能否恢复。同一结构还为研究者或 AI 编码 Agent 新增算法、数据集、模型与任务提供扩展点与自动检查，使 FL 实验可复现、可审计，报告结果可追溯到对应运行记录。
arxiv.reason: 联邦学习实验可复现性工具，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线无直接交集

arxiv.title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
arxiv.titleZh: 参数高效简洁性适配：面向小型语言模型临床推理的可微长度控制
arxiv.summaryZh: 小型语言模型在临床场景部署时，回答长度远超问题所需，而现有长度控制依赖偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，成本与门槛高。PECA在QLoRA监督微调目标中加入一个可微简洁项：由于token数离散不可导，改为在生成超出token预算后提升EOS概率，作为平滑信号在常规训练中优化，无需偏好数据与辅助模型，单张消费级GPU即可完成。在1.7B模型上基于medical-o1-reasoning-SFT微调，平均响应长度降低72.8%，诊断选择题准确率从40.8%升至44.0%，并通过简洁强度扫描给出准确率与长度的可解释权衡前沿。方法可直接迁移到其他需要控制输出冗长度的SFT场景。
arxiv.reason: SFT目标加可微长度正则，属后训练增量方法，医学垂直应用

arxiv.title: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
arxiv.abstract: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.
arxiv.titleZh: 用「能量像素」方法估计第二代DEL需多大才能训练出高分辨率结合模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 小分子结合预测模型若要指导后续药物化学优化，训练数据必须对命中点附近的化学空间密集采样，并包含足够多真正高亲和力的结合物，而多样性天然DEL两者皆缺。该工作把结合视为靶点上「像素」与配体上「反像素」的独立小相互作用之和，仅用天然库中测得的亲和力分布(无结构信息、无需合成)估计第二代DEL所需复杂度。方法把模型所需的紧密结合物数量换算为库应含的化合物数，并给出随机设计第二代DEL的预期产出率，从而为用机器学习或主动学习设计库的效果提供可比较的基线。
arxiv.reason: DNA编码库与结合亲和力建模，属生物医药方向，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: Bellman Contraction under MMD: A Unified Framework
arxiv.abstract: We introduce a mathematical framework for studying contraction of the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). We show that contraction reduces to conditional positive definiteness of an associated kernel constructed from the base kernel, which we call the Bellman difference kernel. Focusing on radial kernels, we use Schoenberg's theorem to connect this condition to Bernstein functions. This gives contraction criteria that hold in any dimension and can be verified analytically or tested numerically. Our framework unifies known results for the Gaussian RBF, power-distance, and multiquadric kernels. A numerical search identifies 11 new kernels that induce contraction. We also propose chaining, a general construction that produces kernels inducing contraction with any prescribed factor. To reconcile theory with practice, we show that contraction on a set only requires conditional positive definiteness on that set. This explains why the RBF kernel can remain a valid choice when rewards are bounded, despite its lack of global contraction. Finally, we identify a fundamental tradeoff between contraction rate and discriminative power, where kernels that contract faster tend to discriminate less between distributions. Code is available at https://github.com/BaptisteDebes/BellmanContractionMMD
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 88 pages, 18 figures, 13 tables
arxiv.titleZh: MMD 下的 Bellman 收缩：一个统一框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 分布强化学习中 Bellman 算子在 MMD 度量下何时收缩，此前缺乏统一判据。该工作把收缩性归结为由基础核构造的 Bellman 差分核的条件正定性，并借 Schoenberg 定理将径向核情形连接到 Bernstein 函数，从而给出任意维度下可解析验证或数值检验的收缩准则。框架统一了 Gaussian RBF、power-distance 与 multiquadric 核的已知结果，数值搜索找出 11 个可诱导收缩的新核，还提出 chaining 构造以得到任意指定收缩因子的核；同时证明集合上的局部收缩只要求该集合上的条件正定性，解释了有界奖励下 RBF 仍可用，并揭示收缩速率与判别力之间的基本权衡。
arxiv.reason: 分布 RL 的 MMD 收缩理论，与 LLM 后训练方向无关

arxiv.title: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
arxiv.abstract: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
arxiv.titleZh: CapLite:面向小语言模型 Agent 的提示注入防御，无需模型编写安全制品
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有提示注入防御(CaMeL、Progent、IPIGuard、DRIFT)依赖 Agent 自身模型编写安全制品(程序、权限策略、依赖图或约束列表)，但在 15 个开放权重模型(13 个为 1.7B–12B)上这类制品普遍失效:模型自写的策略在图、约束上分别可被攻破 14、13、11 个模型，CaMeL 的程序在多达 68% 的 episode 中无法运行。CapLite 改为从工具 schema 直接推导策略，在读取任何工具结果前先提交写调用，并且只有当决定写入对象与影响的全部参数都在用户请求中明确给出时才允许该写入。由此保证写完整性:注入文本无法新增写入，也不会有写入到达用户未声明的收件人、金额、对象或目的地;在 13,935 个受攻击的 AgentDojo episode 中无一攻击成功，受攻击下的效用与 CaMeL 相当(29.0% vs. 27.2%)，每 episode 仅耗 17.1k token(CaMeL 的 18%)，在所有强制型防御中单位 token 效用最高。该工作为小模型 Agent 的部署安全提供了轻量、可验证的替代方案。
arxiv.reason: Agent 提示注入防御，方法新颖有理论保证，实验扎实

arxiv.title: Near-Optimal Regret for Oracle-Efficient Adversarial Contextual Bandits
arxiv.abstract: We study contextual bandits with $K$ actions, a class of $N$ policies, and i.i.d.\ contexts from a distribution that the learner can sample. For any sequence of loss functions fixed before play, we give an oracle-efficient algorithm with expected regret $O(\sqrt{KT\log(2N)}\,\log(2KT))$ against the best policy in hindsight on the realized contexts. This improves the $T^{2/3}$ dependence on the horizon in prior oracle-efficient bounds and achieves the optimal regret rate in this setting up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm perturbs policy scores using a Poisson sample of auxiliary contexts. At each sampled context, the perturbation assigned to an action is a Laplace noise draw multiplied by a scale specific to that context and action. We show that choosing these scales to minimize a convex objective determined by past observations yields the stated regret bound. We further approximate the minimizing scales by projected stochastic gradient descent using only an exact offline cost-sensitive optimization oracle that returns the optimum value. Since the table of scales can be large, the algorithm represents the SGD iterates implicitly by storing the random draws that determine each update and evaluates the scales only at queried contexts. Both the oracle complexity and the remaining resource bounds are polynomial in $T$, $K$, and $\log(2N)$.
arxiv.titleZh: Oracle高效对抗上下文赌博机的近最优遗憾
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究K个动作、N个策略类、上下文可从分布采样的上下文赌博机，在损失序列预先固定的对抗设置下，给出仅依赖离线代价敏感优化oracle的高效算法。算法用辅助上下文的泊松采样扰动策略得分，并按上下文与动作设置拉普拉斯噪声尺度，通过最小化历史观测确定的凸目标来选择尺度；再用投影随机梯度下降仅借助返回最优值的oracle近似尺度，并以隐式表示处理大规模尺度表。期望遗憾为O(√(KT log(2N)) log(2KT))，将此前T^{2/3}的依赖改进到对数因子内最优，oracle复杂度与资源上界均为T、K、log(2N)的多项式。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论，与LLM无关，仅沾RL探索边

arxiv.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).
arxiv.titleZh: LazyWeights:按需解码的边缘端 LLM
arxiv.summaryZh: 边缘设备能运行哪些 LLM、运行多快，受显存容量与带宽限制;而 GPTQ、AWQ、llama.cpp 的 K/I-quant 等格式对矩阵每个整数码分配相同比特，码分布却远非均匀。LazyWeights 保留这些格式，微调 GPTQ 使码可压缩，在交错 lane 上做无损 Huffman 编码，并在 DRAM 与 L2 之间的小单元按需解码，GPU kernel 无需改动、DRAM 只搬运编码字节。1% 与 3.5% 困惑度预算下，编码后的 Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、SmolLM-1.7B 比最优 llama.cpp 格式小 5.7–31.4%;0.21 mm²、1 GHz、7 nm 的 bit-exact ASIC 解码单元把 Orin 每 token 延迟与能耗最多降 36% 与 38%,Nano 上比 CPU llama.cpp 省 58–64% 时间与 53–57% 能耗。
arxiv.reason: 量化权重压缩加按需解码，命中推理效率方向，但含 ASIC 硬件成分

arxiv.title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
arxiv.abstract: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
arxiv.titleZh: 拆解虚假相关：IRM 如何处理文本分类中的多种捷径
arxiv.summaryZh: ERM 训练的文本分类器容易依赖方言标记等虚假特征，损害分布外泛化，而 IRM 在 NLP 中的实际效果仍有争议。该工作用因果驱动框架，在标签生成特征、混淆因素与选择偏差三种捷径机制下系统性评测 IRM，并考察环境变化有限与标签噪声上升的情形。结果显示 IRM 能拒绝各类因果与反因果结构下的捷径；在 Bias in Bios 的性别—职业关联与 ActorCorr 的演员姓名捷径上也有效，但语义上有意义的特征需要谨慎调节不变性惩罚强度。为文本分类的鲁棒性分析与 IRM 调参提供了可复用的评测视角。
arxiv.reason: IRM 与文本分类的虚假相关分析，属鲁棒性方向，与后训练/Agent 主线擦边

arxiv.title: Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States
arxiv.abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving demand for new data centers at large scale and on short deployment timelines. To power them, firms connect to the commercial grid or contract generation directly, but interconnection and gas-turbine delays now incentivize on-site generation. We compare grid-connected and off-grid data center energy infrastructure (AC- and DC-coupled solar-plus-storage, islanded natural gas, and grid interconnection) across the continental U.S. Using an open-source technoeconomic framework built on empirically calibrated AI training loads, climate-driven cooling, stage-by-stage power conversion, and physics-based battery degradation, we model designs providing equivalent energy services. Our central contribution is a speed-adjusted cost of energy that values the compute unlocked by faster construction, making options with different deployment timelines directly comparable on one physically consistent basis. We find DC coupling reduces lifetime energy costs by 18% ($0.09/ kWh) on average versus AC counterparts by eliminating inverters and improving efficiency. Though rarely cheapest on unadjusted energy cost, DC-coupled microgrids' faster deployment makes them the lowest-cost modeled option in 85% of U.S. locations once foregone compute is valued, or 55% under accelerated natural gas timelines. For AI infrastructure, deployment speed rather than unit energy cost determines the economically preferred path to power.
arxiv.titleZh: 并网速度主导 AI 数据中心的能源成本:美国大陆 AI 供电的技术经济分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 AI 数据中心部署周期短、电网互联与燃气轮机交付延迟的现实，构建开源技术经济框架，以实测校准的训练负载、气候驱动制冷、逐级功率变换与基于物理的电池衰减为输入，在同一物理口径下比较并网、AC/DC 耦合光伏加储能与孤岛天然气等方案，并提出「速度调整后度电成本」，把提前建成所解锁的算力计入收益。结果显示 DC 耦合因省去逆变器、效率更高，平均降低全生命周期能源成本 18%(约 0.09 美元/kWh);计入错失算力后，DC 耦合微电网在全美 85% 地点成为最低成本方案，天然气加速交付情形下为 55%。结论是 AI 基础设施的供电选型由部署速度而非单位电价决定。
arxiv.reason: 数据中心供电技术经济分析，仅以 LLM 负载为输入，偏离关注方向

arxiv.title: Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography
arxiv.abstract: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction. Existing fixes change the distribution, synchronize whole pools of tokens at a capacity that collapses with large vocabularies, or track several token histories. We prove that if extraction is exact and error-free across full-support language models, a single-history receiver is confined to a prefix-free candidate set at every step -- even if it reads the entire future text and the sender constrains later steps -- and must therefore give up the stop entropy, the entropy of deciding whether each prefix token ends there. Fixing these stop decisions on the prefix forest with shared randomness yields coin projection: a closed-form scheme that attains the bound, works with any distribution coder in one model call per token, preserves ordinary sampling, and refines SyncPool for every key. Across English, Chinese and Japanese, ambiguous text is rare (at most 11 in 1,000 tokens), yet the stop entropy at word and morpheme prefixes takes 7.2-9.0% of the entropy at every step; SyncPool's further loss comes from space and single-byte UTF-8 hubs that merge subtrees while carrying almost no stop uncertainty. Coin projection keeps 91-93% of the string entropy for the coder at every vocabulary size; with the full vocabulary, it turns 2.16-6.85 times as much entropy into message bits as SyncPool and recovers every completed message.
arxiv.titleZh: 可证明安全语言隐写的最优单历史分词消歧
arxiv.summaryZh: 可证明安全语言隐写要求接收端还原发送端token，但文本信道的分词歧义会破坏提取。该工作证明单历史接收端须放弃前缀停止熵，并提出coin projection：在前缀森林上用共享随机性固定停止决策，兼容任意分布编码器、每token一次模型调用且保持普通采样。英中日歧义文本至多11/1000token，停止熵占每步7.2%–9.0%；方法保留91%–93%字符串熵，全词表下相对SyncPool将2.16–6.85倍熵转为消息比特并完整恢复消息。
arxiv.reason: 语言模型隐写与分词消歧，偏离后训练/Agent主线

arxiv.title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
arxiv.abstract: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.
arxiv.titleZh: LoRA 领域适配中的推理监督与能力保持
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对金融领域微调基础模型时既要提升任务性能又不能损害泛化能力的问题，系统比较了 Qwen3-8B 上的三种 LoRA 训练方案：仅对标签计算损失的 response-only LoRA、把教师模型推理轨迹与标签一并纳入损失的单适配器推理训练，以及为轨迹和标签各训一个 LoRA 适配器的双适配器复合训练。结果显示，response-only LoRA 的域内提升最大（主要体现在校准与 argmax 准确率），通用能力接近冻结模型；单适配器推理的域内指标落后于 response-only，但 MMLU-Pro 略有上升，其余保持基准处于正常波动范围；双适配器复合训练没有带来额外收益。把教师轨迹先摘要压缩再训练，可使校准向 response-only 靠拢但未达到同等水平。
arxiv.reason: LoRA 蒸馏与能力保持的系统消融，切中后训练但增量有限

arxiv.title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
arxiv.abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过程序演化发现有效的Agent记忆设计
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent记忆系统的设计长期依赖人工经验，缺乏系统化的自动搜索手段。MAPE以极简种子程序为起点，通过标准化的生命周期接口与「诊断—提出」迭代循环，直接演化出完整的记忆程序。在LoCoMo与LongMemEval上，其准确率较人工设计基线最高提升12个百分点，服务成本仅为后者的35%，并可跨服务后端与benchmark迁移。分析归纳出两条可复用设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据，以及按查询意图组合检索证据；将组合模块移植到五个现有记忆系统后全部获得提升。此外，把服务成本纳入搜索目标会使计算从基于LLM的记忆构建转向查询时的选择性处理。
arxiv.reason: 程序演化自动搜索Agent记忆设计，实验扎实且有可迁移结论

arxiv.title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
arxiv.abstract: Online conformal risk control (OCRC) enables reliable uncertainty quantification in machine learning by converting model outputs into prediction sets with long-term risk guarantees. These guarantees, however, hinge on the assumption that the loss of each round is revealed immediately and losslessly. In practice, feedback may be delayed, and limited resources may prevent tracking all pending predictions, causing some feedback to be lost. To address this challenge, we develop capacity-aware OCRC (CA-OCRC), a framework that jointly determines how to allocate limited tracking feedback capacity and how to construct prediction sets. CA-OCRC is based on a randomized tracking policy that samples a proxy delay to decide whether, and for how long, feedback for the current round is tracked. CA-OCRC updates the prediction sets via inverse probability weighting, compensating for the possibility of feedback lost due to delays and limited tracking capacity. We analyze risk bounds for both arbitrary and stochastic delays, revealing a trade-off between receiving more feedback and avoiding capacity saturation. Building on these bounds, we optimize the proxy delay distribution, showing scaling laws for the tracking capacity that ensure the same long-term risk as OCRC with unlimited feedback. Experiments on medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications show the effectiveness of CA-OCRC as compared to existing OCRC mechanisms.
arxiv.titleZh: 容量受限的延迟反馈下的在线共形风险控制
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线共形风险控制（OCRC）的长期风险保证依赖每轮损失即时且无损地反馈，但现实中反馈存在延迟，跟踪资源也有限，部分反馈会因此丢失。CA-OCRC 采用随机化跟踪策略：为每轮抽取一个代理延迟，据此决定是否跟踪以及跟踪多久；再用逆概率加权更新预测集，补偿因延迟和容量受限导致的反馈缺失。作者给出任意延迟与随机延迟下的风险界，揭示「接收更多反馈」与「避免容量饱和」之间的权衡，并据此优化代理延迟分布，导出保证与无限反馈 OCRC 同等长期风险所需的跟踪容量 scaling law。实验覆盖医学影像、自然语言处理、计算机视觉与无线通信。
arxiv.reason: 共形预测理论研究，与 LLM 后训练、Agent 无直接交集

arxiv.title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.

arxiv.titleZh: 评估预训练语言语义在结构化EHR预测任务中的作用
arxiv.summaryZh: 结构化EHR模型通常把每个临床概念当作数据集专属token，丢弃事件附带的自然语言语义，概念间关系只能靠共现学习。tEHR把事件写成自然语言描述，以该文本流做EHR自适应继续预训练，再用LoRA做任务判别式微调，将LLM用作纵向患者编码器。在MIMIC-IV的四个预测任务与CPRD的胰腺癌预测上按1至12个月窗口评估，Mistral-7B-v0.3主干整体表现最优;消融显示删除临床描述、描述错位、省略数值或去掉任一适配阶段都会掉点，显式病程时间描述增益很小，学到的患者表征呈现与疾病风险和病史相关的临床一致结构。
arxiv.reason: 医疗EHR纵向预测的LLM适配应用，属垂直领域，相关性有限

arxiv.title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
arxiv.titleZh: 审计 AI 同行评审：基于真实科学论文的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 同行评审已进入生产使用，但评估手段有限。这份工作构建了一个审计基准：向真实论文注入四类（一般问题、数学、数值、引用）、三级严重度的可定位错误，按错误类型与严重度测量检出率，并统计干净副本上的假阳性；同时提出多智能体评审器 Skepthical，用检索被引论文、计算机代数与代码执行分别核验引用、数学与数值主张。在天体物理与 ML 两个各含 15 篇 arXiv 预印本的语料上共注入 357 个错误，并评测 12 个系统：同一提示下三个前沿 LLM 的总检出率相差约 50 个百分点，工具与 scaffold 仅在补足模型自身短板时有效，Skepthical 的引用检出在天体物理大幅领先、在 ML 上与最强单模型无统计差异。
arxiv.reason: LLM 评审基准与多智能体 scaffold，契合评测方法学与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent's context. Yet delegation helps only when task allocation and subtask execution are coordinated: the main agent must issue useful subtasks, while subagents must return reliable evidence. Existing training either optimizes only the main agent or broadcasts the same team advantage to all agents, which can reward misleading subagent reports and penalize useful ones. We introduce LEAD-RL (Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning), a joint main-agent-subagent training framework with contribution-aware credit assignment. A training-time rubric evaluates the research utility of each subagent report and gates its inherited team advantage, while final-answer correctness remains the only team reward; no token, step, or speedup reward is used. Across five benchmarks and two model families, LEAD-RL improves answer quality. On BrowseComp, it improves accuracy by 2.49 percentage points and reduces critical-path cost by 24.5% over joint training with shared team credit. During validation, accuracy increases by 6.78 points at approximately constant critical-path cost. These results show that contribution-aware credit assignment improves the quality-efficiency trade-off of multi-agent deep research.
arxiv.titleZh: 从委派到协同：学习高效的多智能体深度研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体深度研究依赖主智能体委派子任务以并行搜索并把冗长工具轨迹挡在主上下文之外，但只有当主智能体给出有用子任务、子智能体返回可靠证据时委派才有效。LEAD-RL提出主智能体与子智能体联合训练框架，用贡献感知的信用分配：训练时用评分规则评估每份子智能体报告的研究价值，并据此门控其继承的团队优势，而团队奖励仍只由最终答案正确性决定，不使用 token、步数或加速奖励。在五个 benchmark 与两个模型家族上，BrowseComp 准确率提升 2.49 个百分点，关键路径成本降低 24.5%；验证阶段准确率提升 6.78 点而关键路径成本基本不变。该工作表明细粒度信用分配可改善多智能体深度研究的质量—效率权衡，适用于 Agentic RL 与多智能体协同训练场景。

arxiv.title: Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
arxiv.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data. We show that a vision foundation model that has never seen EEG is a stronger frozen EEG encoder than these specialized models, once the signals are rendered as images that a vision transformer can read. Our method, SeeEEG, keeps the vision backbone frozen and learns only how EEG is displayed to it. Each channel occupies a dedicated row of patches and is drawn either as a waveform at a fixed gain or as a scalogram whose frequency range spans the patch height, so that task-relevant patterns fall within individual tokens. The montage, filtering, and contrast parameters of this display are initialized from a standard clinical montage and optimized with the task loss through the frozen backbone, which amounts to at most 1,113 trainable parameters per view. We compare SeeEEG with seven EEG foundation models on eight clinical, sleep, affective, and brain-computer interface datasets, with every encoder frozen and paired with identical readout heads. With a frozen DINOv3 ViT-B, SeeEEG outperforms every EEG foundation model in balanced accuracy on all eight datasets and reaches a mean rank of 1.3 in Cohen kappa or AUROC, compared with 2.9 for the strongest baseline, REVE. The learned displays transfer without further optimization to the video encoder V-JEPA 2.1, which outperforms every EEG foundation model on both metrics on six of the eight datasets. Replacing DINOv3 with a randomly initialized ViT-B lowers the score by 15.2 points on average, so the ability to read rendered EEG comes from visual pretraining.
arxiv.titleZh: 你的视觉基础模型其实是 EEG 基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: EEG 基础模型的冻结特征迁移效果差，且不随模型规模与预训练数据量稳定提升。SeeEEG 把多通道 EEG 按导联排成图像块行，绘制为固定增益波形或覆盖块高的时频图，仅优化显示参数（每视图至多 1113 个可训练参数），DINOv3 ViT-B 主干全程冻结。在 8 个临床、睡眠、情感与脑机接口数据集上，其平衡准确率全部超过 7 个 EEG 基础模型，kappa 或 AUROC 平均排名 1.3，最强基线 REVE 为 2.9；学到的显示参数可直接迁移到 V-JEPA 2.1，在 6/8 数据集上领先。换成随机初始化 ViT-B 平均降 15.2 点，表明读图能力来自视觉预训练。
arxiv.reason: 视觉基础模型跨域迁移至 EEG 解码，偏离 LLM 关注方向

arxiv.title: Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models
arxiv.abstract: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics. We argue that this framing conflates genuine redundancy with topics that are semantically similar but meaningfully distinct, and that the central challenge in high-granularity modelling is separating the two. Recent post-hoc refinement methods address topic redundancy through either embedding-based similarity thresholding or LLM-guided merging. We show that neither suffices in high-granularity settings and propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM), a hybrid approach that iteratively generates context-rich topic representations, uses embedding similarity to propose candidate merges across the topic space, then applies LLM judgement to accept only genuinely redundant pairs while preserving niche distinctions. Across two patent corpora and one legal corpus, LLM judgement rejects 83% of embedding-identified candidates as non-redundant. EGIM improves discriminability on merged topics by 25-55% over a prior iterative LLM baseline while better preserving the original topic distribution.
arxiv.titleZh: 相似但不冗余:面向高粒度主题模型的嵌入门控精炼
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对高粒度主题建模中主题碎片化、冗余子主题频现的问题，指出真正冗余与语义相近但实则不同的细分主题常被混为一谈，关键在于区分二者。提出的 EGIM 混合方法迭代生成富含上下文的话题表示，用嵌入相似度在主题空间中提出候选合并，再由 LLM 判定只接受真正冗余的对，从而保留细分差异。在两个专利语料与一个法律语料上，LLM 判定否决了 83% 的嵌入候选为非冗余;合并后主题的可区分性较已有迭代 LLM 基线提升 25–55%，同时更好地保留原主题分布。适用需从大规模语料中抽取数百细分主题的场景。
arxiv.reason: 高粒度主题建模的 LLM 辅助合并，偏离后训练/Agent 主线应用

arxiv.title: Temporal Regularized Learning: Self-Supervised Learning Local in Space and Time
arxiv.abstract: Layer-local self-supervised objectives remove the backward pass between layers, but almost all still compute their loss over a batch of samples and are therefore local in space but not in time. We introduce Temporal Regularized Learning (TeReL), a spatially and temporally local learning rule for self-supervised representation learning from sequential input streams. The key idea is to instantiate a VICReg-style objective with temporally adjacent positives and non-differentiated running population statistics, yielding a per-neuron online loss with bounded state. The objective is a soft form of Slow Feature Analysis, and its gradient is a Hebbian update of the feedforward weights and an anti-Hebbian update of one lateral matrix per layer. The aim of the experiments is to show that the rule works in a small network, not to compete with backpropagation. On a class-chunked MNIST stream, a two-layer fully connected network trained with batch size one outperforms random features (96.48% versus 95.09% linear-probe accuracy) and classical SFA, and a variant that relaxes both locality constraints is comparable to supervised backpropagation. Because training and inference use the same computation, the network can keep learning from unlabeled data during inference without loss of accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 时间正则化学习:在空间与时间上均局部化的自监督学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 逐层局部自监督目标免去了层间反向传播，但损失仍在样本batch上计算，因此只在空间上局部、在时间上不局部。TeReL用时间相邻正样本和不参与求导的运行总体统计量构建VICReg式目标，由此得到每个神经元、状态有界的在线损失;该目标是Slow Feature Analysis的软化形式，其梯度为前馈权重的Hebbian更新，加上每层一个侧抑制矩阵的anti-Hebbian更新。在按类别分块输入的MNIST流上，两层全连接网络以batch size 1训练取得96.48%线性探针精度，高于随机特征的95.09%与经典SFA，而放宽两项局部性约束的变体接近有监督反向传播;训练与推理使用相同计算，因此推理时可继续从无标签数据学习而不掉精度。
arxiv.reason: 局部学习规则、小规模MNIST实验，与LLM方向基本无关

arxiv.title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users. In long-horizon tasks, subgoals, available inputs, and environmental states change as execution progresses. Agents must select currently applicable skills from an expanding skill pool and prepare candidates for subsequent steps. We propose Skill Adapter, which enables personalized modification and online routing of general-purpose skills. The system distills local adjustments from user requirements and execution feedback and stores them as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills. The routing agent selects general-purpose skills and applicable Adapters based on the current subtask, execution progress, and environmental feedback, incrementally maintaining a task-level online skill library that the main LLM reads on demand. The system preloads candidates for subsequent nodes and rechecks their applicability once actual inputs are determined. Reinforcement learning optimizes the two types of decisions using modification gains and routing outcomes, respectively. We evaluate Skill Adapter on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench. Compared with SkillRL, it improves task success rates by an average of 11.43 percentage points and reduces mean execution time on all three benchmarks. Skill Adapter retains its performance advantage when the skill pool grows to 1,000 skills.
arxiv.titleZh: Skill Adapter:通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 通用技能库中共享的执行流程难以适配不同用户的工具选择与输出要求，长程任务中子目标与环境状态又不断变化，技能选取与准备成为瓶颈。Skill Adapter 从用户需求与执行反馈中蒸馏局部调整，以 Adapter 形式挂载在通用技能上，并由路由 agent 依据当前子任务、执行进度与环境反馈选择技能及对应 Adapter，增量维护主模型按需读取的任务级在线技能库，还预加载后续节点候选并在实际输入确定后复核适用性;两类决策分别用修改收益与路由结果做强化学习优化。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 与 SkillsBench 上，任务成功率相对 SkillRL 平均提升 11.43 个百分点，三个基准的平均执行时间均下降，技能池扩至 1000 个时仍保持优势。
arxiv.reason: Agent 技能库个性化与在线路由，含 Agentic RL，命中 Agent 方向
